{{- /* Bare-symbol-name -> reference path index, derived from a version's generated api_refs lookup (keyed `.`), passed as the context. Names that exist in more than one package are dropped rather than guessed, so callers never link an ambiguous mention to the wrong package. Call through partialCached with the version as the variant — this walks every symbol and only needs to run once per version. */ -}} {{- $index := dict -}} {{- $ambiguous := slice -}} {{- range $slug, $entry := . -}} {{- $name := index (last 1 (split $slug ".")) 0 -}} {{- if isset $index $name -}} {{- $ambiguous = $ambiguous | append $name -}} {{- else -}} {{- $index = merge $index (dict $name $entry.path) -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- range $ambiguous -}} {{- $index = merge $index (dict . "") -}} {{- end -}} {{- return $index -}}
